headline: Chaminade remain without a win this season
dek: Chaminade have lost eleven matches and drawn one, a goalless draw at Hawai'i Hilo, scoring five goals and conceding twenty-six. In goal, Jonah Valmonte has made thirty-four saves at a save percentage of .723.
